dz: 戴克里先皇帝和马克西米安皇帝任命康斯坦提乌斯·克洛鲁斯和加莱里乌斯为凯撒。这被认为是四帝制的开始，被称为 Quattuor Principes Mundi（“世界四位统治者”）。
de: Emperor Diocletian and Maximian appoint Constantius Chlorus and Galerius as Caesars. This is considered the beginning of the Tetrarchy, known as the Quattuor Principes Mundi ("Four Rulers of the World").

dz: 罗马皇帝戴克里先和马克西米安任命加莱里乌斯为戴克里先的凯撒，开始了被称为“四帝统治”的四位统治者时期。
de: Roman Emperors Diocletian and Maximian appoint Galerius as Caesar to Diocletian, beginning the period of four rulers known as the Tetrarchy.
